name: kb_beast_mastery_hunter
notes: The Turtle knowledge base's beast mastery raid list as far as a rotation can say it: Bestial Wrath on cooldown, Steady Shot as the loop, Arcane Shot, Multi-Shot and Volley on packs. Kill Command, the pet's Felstorm/Thunderstomp and the pet trinkets are pet state; the swing timer is not a condition. Aimed Shot and Serpent Sting are the oracle's never list.
